test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **What is the advice given by established cartoonists?**

options.text: Do not assume you can become a cartoonists just because you can sketch.
Everyone has the talent to become a good cartoonist.
Cartoons that make us laugh should have pointed one-liners.
Knowledge of current affairs is important for a cartoonist.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Do not assume you can become a cartoonists just because you can sketch.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the last line of the given passage, it is mentioned that the advice that established cartoonists give is that just because **you can sketch, don't take it for granted that you will become a successful cartoonist.**
 
• The last line implies one's talent at sketching should not be confused with becoming a successful cartoonist. One needs to have **creativity **and **humor **to flourish in the career of a cartoonist and these cannot be taught to someone.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
